sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Polyresin Vacuum Casting and Hand-Painted Limited Edition Statues

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 21 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework, as amended), implemented by Decreto Ejecutivo No. 406 de 19 de diciembre de 2019 establishing the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) administered by the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI); corporate sourcing statute: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 under the Registro Público de Panamá; enforcement and supervision by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney in favor of the Panamanian incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (preferred, Panama is an HCCH member since 1991) OR Consular Legalization at a Panamanian Consulate for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each proposed shareholder, director, and officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public or competent administrative authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague states), followed by Spanish translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Certificate of Good Standing and board resolution of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction companies registry and corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague states), followed by Spanish translation and notarized authentication by resident agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (banker's reference) covering the beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution in the country of residence of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague states) when used as a notarial exhibit; otherwise accepted as a direct professional reference

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, and beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, EU consolidated financial sanctions, and Panama's national caution/PEP lists maintained by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF). Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) require enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds documentation, and senior-management approval; negative-media and sanctions re-screening applies at onboarding, on any UBO or officer change, and periodically thereafter, with suspicious activity reporting to the UAF under Ley No. 23 de 2015.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Ventanilla Única de Empresa (Panamá Emprende): www.panamaemprende.gob.pa and www.registropublico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be substantially distinguishable from existing registrations and may be expressed in the Latin/Roman alphabet; a Spanish denomination is standard but not compulsory. The registered corporate name must carry the distinguishing element 'Sociedad Anónima' (or the abbreviation 'S.A.'). The Public Registry may reject names that are phonetically or visually confusingly similar to an existing entity, and will transliterate foreign-script names into the local script where a non-Roman alphabet is presented; a Spanish translation of the supporting certificate is then required.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected by the Registro Público de Panamá, the applicant (through the registered agent) may re-file with a modified name or file a written recurso de reconsideración before the Registrar within five business days of notification, supplying a search-and-distinctiveness memorandum. A sustained denial may be appealed via recurso de apelación to the Director General of the Public Registry, and ultimately by judicial review to the Sala Tercera (Contencioso-Administrativo) of the Corte Suprema de Justicia under Ley No. 38 de 2000. A name reservation may be renewed by resubmission within the 30-day validity window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or the resident agent's address may lawfully serve as the statutory registered office of the Panamanian S.A. For the polyresin statue activity, the Panamanian vehicle can remain a territorial holding/contracting entity with the agent's office in Panama City as its registered address; however, payment processors and international banks (Stripe, PayPal, correspondent banks) will require a verified physical operational address, a commercial bank account, and demonstrable commercial substance in the operating jurisdiction, so a pure virtual office is not sufficient to support payment-rail onboarding.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a low-risk standard-tier S.A.: estimated 10–20% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first corporate year, driven primarily by the resident agent's statutory record-keeping obligations (DGI/UAF document checks); inspections are unlikely to be triggered solely by the manufacture of resin statues, but use of personal credit-card preorders and PayPal rails will prompt verification-based AML reviews by acquiring banks.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and search certificate with the Public Registry (Ventanilla Única de Empresa)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá / Panamá Emprende

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting and notarization of the Articles of Incorporation (Acta Constitutiva) of the Sociedad Anónima
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (S.A. formation flat fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the S.A. charter with the Registro Público de Panamá (Sección Mercantil)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on authorized capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificado de Persona Jurídica (Certificate of Incorporation) and certified charter excerpt
Resident agent appointment for year one, including registered office service in Panama City
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed resident agent (Panamanian law firm or corporate services provider)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/KYC file preparation and PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening of UBOs, directors, and officers
Beneficial owner initial registration with the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) through the DGI portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) / resident agent processing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative compliance handling charge (no statutory filing fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of shareholder documents and Spanish translations of the corporate file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in jurisdiction of origin and/or Panamanian Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fee schedules plus prevailing translation rates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 sobre Sociedades Anónimas (Panamanian General Corporation Law), as amended by Law 62 of 2013; Articles 1-15 (incorporation), 20-28 (registered office and resident agent), 29-37 (share capital and subscription), and 38-48 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama), Mercantile Section (Sección Mercantil) - general office located in Panama City with regional branches.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Notarized Public Deed of Incorporation), including the Pacto Social and Estatutos; the deed becomes a registered mercantile instrument after inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required under Panamanian law. The Escritura Pública must state the authorized capital (capital autorizado) and the subscribed/paid amount; shares may be paid in installments or in kind. No escrow or banking deposit rule applies for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], S.A. — RESOLVED: 1. The Board acknowledges the subscription of all issued shares by the subscriber, payment of which has been made in the form permitted by the articles of incorporation and fully satisfied as per the capital statement. 2. The registered office is established at [Address], Panama City, Republic of Panama, and the resident agent is confirmed. 3. The following officers are appointed: President, Treasurer, Secretary, and Resident Agent, each granted full powers of representation and banking authority subject to the bylaws. 4. The Board authorizes the officers to execute any documents and take all measures to obtain operational registrations and commence lawful business operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reservation and Pre-Clearance of the Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Registro Mercantil (online via the TRACE platform or customer service counters)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a request in the Registro Público for a name search and reservation of a proposed company name, which must include the letters 'S.A.' or 'Sociedad Anónima'. The registry issues a non-conflicting name certificate (certificado de búsqueda) valid for 30 days. This step is mandatory before notarizing the deed.
required_dossiers: Completed name search/reservation form
Copy of the applicant attorney's professional ID (cédula/idoneidad)
List of up to three alternative corporate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is reserved for another entity or is phonetically identical, submit a written substitution of name within 5 business days; if the certificate expires before use, re-apply online and pay a minimal re-issuance fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público de la República de Panamá (licensed public notary) acting on legal advice of a Panamanian attorney (abogado idóneo)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws and capital structure of the S.A., including the corporate purpose covering the manufacturing, vacuum casting, hand-painting and distribution of polyresin statues and related toy/game products (ISIC 3240/NAICS 339930). The subscriber and appointed directors must appear before the notary to sign the Escritura Pública. The notary incorporates the deed into the protocol and issues certified testimonies.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name reservation
Passport or identity card of the subscriber and initial directors
Draft bylaws containing capital structure, officers, domicile and purpose clause
If the subscriber is a legal entity, a certified corporate resolution and evidence of the signing officer's authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies an incompatibility between the purpose clause and the corporate purpose catalogue, amend the deed by a supplementary Escritura de aclaración and re-notarize; any defects in the subscriber's authority require a nuova or corrective power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration and Inscription of the Deed at the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección de Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Filed via TRACE portal or the registry window, the notarized testimonio, the original registration form and proof of fee payment. The registry verifies the legality of the incorporation clauses, the name, and the solvency of the notarial act, and then issues the Ficha Electrónica (electronic record) with a R.P. number, converting the company into a legal entity with juridical personality.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Escritura Pública (testimonio)
Original name reservation certificate
Filled Registro Mercantil application form (Formulario de Registro)
Payment of registration stamps and fees (papel sellado y timbres fiscales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a registry observation (reparo), the attorney files a written explanation and document correction within 10 business days; if the registrar rejects a clause, submit a new Escritura de rectificación before re-payment of the reduced fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Aviso de Operación and Patente Municipal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá - Tesorería Municipal (or the corresponding Alcaldía if located in another district), assisted by the Ventanilla Única de Inversión (VUI) for coordination
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, file the application for the Aviso de Operación indicating the industrial/artisan manufacturing activity. The municipality verifies the address, conducts an inspection of the premises (size, safety and electricity), and issues the municipal patent with the corresponding annual patent fee calculated on declared operating capital. For low-scale garage-kit operations, no separate manufacturing license is required.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Escritura Pública registered at the Public Registry
RUC provisional or final certificate issued by DGI
Lease agreement or property title of the production premises
Municipal inspection request form
Payment of the first year patent fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inspection is delayed, request confirmation in writing and temporarily pay the first-year fee; if the municipality requires an additional zoning certificate, submit the property and land use approval from the local planning department within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (RUC) and Fiscal Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance - online through the SIAFE/ITICE portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) using the company's registered data. Select the fiscal activities: manufacturing, import and wholesale of polyresin figures through digital channels; register for income tax, ITBMS sales tax, and withholding tax obligations. Request the digital certificate and electronic invoicing activation to support future Stripe and PayPal settlement accounting.
required_dossiers: Registered Escritura Pública (Copia registrada) and Public Registry certificate
Aviso de Operación municipal
RUC form signed by legal representative and certified accountant (Contador Público Autorizado)
Identity documents of directors and the accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI objects to a fiscal activity, submit an amending form through the SIAFE portal with a written explanation from the CPA; blocked RUCs due to missing returns are released after presenting the corresponding filing or a formal request for reinstatement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Activation of Payment Rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian commercial bank authorized by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá, in coordination with the resident agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the complete corporate and governance package to the bank's compliance officer to open a USD corporate account. Obtain wire and ACH capabilities, then activate Stripe and PayPal business accounts under the Panamanian S.A. using the certificate of continuation (personería jurídica) and bank statement as proof of physical location.
required_dossiers: Copia registrada of the Escritura Pública and certificate of good standing (Personería)
RUC and Aviso de Operación
Certified passport copies of directors and ultimate beneficial owner
Proof of residential address of the operating manager
Corporate resolution appointing signatories
Completed bank risk profile questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the compliance officer requests enhanced diligence for artisan exports, submit a flow-of-funds diagram, customer invoices and supplier documentation for the resin materials; any refusal under Law 23 of 2015 must be followed by a formal re-application with additional legal analysis.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) - Dirección de Comercio Interior; municipal patent office of the local Alcaldía
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Aviso de Operación (Patente Municipal) - valid for all commercial and artisan industrial activities; no separate manufacturing license is demanded for small-batch polyresin statue production, although voluntary registration with MICI is available for export facilitation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Verificación del Desempeño Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I - Low Impact Environmental Registration (Registro de Actividades de Bajo Impacto Ambiental), applicable to small workshop-scale resin casting and hand-painting operations; a Full EIA Study is not required unless production exceeds 200 liters of synthetic resin per month or discharges over 10 cubic meters per day of industrial wastewater.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to municipal sewer must comply with Panamanian quality thresholds of pH 6.5-8.5, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 250 mg/L and TSS ≤ 100 mg/L; undiluted resin and paint waste must be solidified and disposed as hazardous waste. Airborne VOC emissions from vacuum casting and hand-painting must be controlled through local exhaust ventilation to keep 8-hour TWA exposures below ACGIH limits (styrene 10 ppm, acetone 500 ppm, isocyanates 0.005 ppm), and waste catalysts, hardeners and solvents must be stored in closed drums and removed by an authorized waste transporter under a manifest.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (Certificado del Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá) verifying extinguishers, evacuation routes and safe storage of combustible resins; structural and electrical clearance for the casting workshop from the municipal engineering department (Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal); and workplace registration with MITRADEL, including a hygiene and safety plan, material safety data sheets (MSDS) for chemicals, and personal protective equipment programs.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); electronic portal: Sede Electrónica / e-Tax 2.0 (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Sociedad Anónima, the DGI RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) is obtained by filing the Formulario de Inscripción RUC through a Panamanian resident agent, attaching certified articles of incorporation from the Registro Público, passport copies of officers/shareholders, evidence of registered fiscal address in Panama, and the appointment of a fiscal representative; registration must follow company formation and precedes any taxable transaction. A simplified RUC inscription procedure applies to non-resident digital service suppliers under Ley 176 de 2021.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election is available; the S.A. is mandatorily taxed at entity level on Panama-source income only (25% corporate income tax). Optional fiscal elections include adoption of full IFRS accounting basis with DGI approval, and election by foreign digital service suppliers to file under the simplified ITBMS registration regime; no fiscally transparent pass-through status exists for a Sociedad Anónima.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: PAB - No general monetary turnover threshold: RUC and ITBMS inscription are mandatory from the first commercial or industrial activity in Panama. Non-resident digital service suppliers must register and charge ITBMS on supplies to Panamanian consumers with no de minimis threshold under Ley 176 de 2021.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) with phased DGI rollout: invoices must be issued through DGI-authorised electronic invoicing service providers (PES) with real-time transmission, digital validation/signing by DGI, and inclusion of a verification code/QR code; no traditional physical fiscal stamp is used. Taxpayers integrating through the DGI e-Tax 2.0 platform must transmit invoice sets and receive electronic confirmation for each document.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (i) tangible goods physically exported from Panama with title and risk transferred to the non-resident buyer, evidenced by customs exit; (ii) services provided to non-residents that are effectively used or consumed wholly outside Panama; and (iii) offshore services benefiting non-resident recipients. The exporter must hold valid RUC status, issue the invoice with PAN-specific export documentation, and retain proof of departure within the period required by DGI.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Panama customs export declaration (Declaración Única de Exportación ratified by the Dirección Nacional de Aduanas)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill with Panamanian departure port/airport evidence
Commercial invoice (factura comercial) referencing the RUC and ITBMS zero-rated condition
Packing list and certificate of origin where claimed
Inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DGI disallows zero-rating for missing or fraudulent export evidence, the ITBMS at 7% is clawed back on the gross invoice amount, with interest, late payment surcharges, and administrative fines under Articles 708-711 of the Código Fiscal (up to 100% of the omitted tax); deliberate falsification of customs or banking documents additionally triggers criminal tax fraud liability and disqualification of the RUC/export privileges, with liability extending to the resident agent acting in bad faith.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) acting as the banking regulator; Banco Nacional de Panamá as the fiscal agent of the state; no central bank with monetary authority is present.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates under full dollarization with the US dollar as legal tender and the Balboa as a purely nominal currency unit. Current and capital account items are freely convertible, with no exchange control regime, no differentiated current/capital account treatment, no prior central bank approval for remittances, and no dividend or profit repatriation restrictions beyond standard corporate solvency and tax compliance requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion requirement exists. Export receipts may be retained, freely used, or remitted abroad in US dollars without any mandatory percentage conversion into local currency.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Panama permits regulated banks and certain supervised non-bank financial institutions to offer payment and e-money services, but no dedicated EMI licensing framework equivalent to the EU or UK is in place. Offshore digital EMIs are not permitted to conduct banking intermediation, take deposits, or clear funds for Panamanian customers without a local license or an authorized local bank partner. A remote-opening-only EMI without SBP authorization faces legal constraints; practical feasibility is limited to USD nostro-backed payment facilitators that use licensed Panamanian banks for underlying settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for corporate account opening, specifically for the legal representative or a designated officer with power of attorney. In practice, directors may authorize a local attorney-in-fact to attend the underwriting interview. Full remote opening is offered by some tier-1 banks only for low-risk corporate clients under enhanced videoconference KYC procedures, subject to SBP regulations; however, the default compliance posture is physical or authorized representation with notarized documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ownership complexity involving beneficial owners outside Panama without transparent identity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed Panama beneficial ownership declaration (Declaración de Titularidad), identity documents and passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, corporate chart with ownership percentages, source of funds documentation, and a sworn affidavit confirming absence of PEP status where relevant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipt of international prepayments for limited edition resin statues without prior trading history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export sales contracts, proforma invoices, quotation in USD, historical shipping documentation, proof of product supply chain, warehouse lease or production capacity evidence, and bank reference letters from previous jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or frequent inbound wires from payment facilitators such as Stripe or PayPal
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment facilitator settlement statements, merchant processing agreements, online store URL with product catalogue, and a reconciliation ledger of customer preorders and ship-based fulfillment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of capital escrow accounts for preorder deposits without statutory escrow license
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal opinion confirming the arrangement constitutes customer-funded production deposits rather than regulated escrow activity, commercial order forms, refund policy, and evidence that the company records liabilities and fulfills orders in ordinary course.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant incoming shareholder capital injections use the SWIFT MT103 wire protocol to a Panama USD nostro account. The wire must reference the corporate entity's name, tax ID (RUC), and account number. Panama imposes no exchange control declaration; however, banks require a purpose code or free-text explanation such as 'Capital Contribution pursuant to Shareholder Resolution' or 'Preorder Deposit for Commercial Sale'. Supporting documentation includes the shareholder resolution, board resolution, articles of incorporation, and proof of source of funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement of trade liabilities for raw materials and manufacturing services uses SWIFT MT103 (direct wire) for supplier payments and commercial documentary letters of credit (LC) for bulk procurement. Where an LC is used, it is typically an irrevocable at-sight LC confirmed by a US or Panamanian bank. For small supplier balances, MT103 is the approved clearing rail. All outbound disbursements require underlying commercial invoices, transport documents, and board approval, given the strict AML expectation for export-oriented manufacturing entities.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: No NDF or currency swap market is permissible or necessary because Panama's functional and settlement currency is the US dollar.

Plain vanilla FX forwards may be offered by international banks outside Panama but require a genuine underlying commercial exposure in a foreign currency; if invoices are USD-denominated, no admissible forward is needed.
Cross-currency swaps are permissible only for actual USD-to-foreign-currency operating exposure; purely speculative instruments are disallowed under standard Panamanian banking conduct rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax – Tasa Única Anual (S.A. Good Standing Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; payment cleared through the Registro Público for good-standing maintenance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31; newly incorporated S.A.s pay a prorated first fee but must be in good standing by March 31 following incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a 10% surcharge plus 1% monthly interest; failure for three consecutive years authorizes administrative strike-off (disolución) by the Registro Público and cancellation of the corporate status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final – Annual UBO Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Beneficial Ownership Registry under Law 23 of 2015
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than January 31 for the preceding calendar year; also required within 30 days of any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of up to USD 500 per corporation; issuance of certificates of good standing is blocked; the resident agent may be jointly fined; persistent non-compliance suspends corporate registry transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta – Annual Income Tax Return for Panamanian-Source Operations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers, due on or before March 31 for the preceding fiscal year; electronic filing extensions may apply under DGI protocols
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 5%–10% of the assessed tax, plus monthly interest at the statutory DGI rate; failure to file authorizes best-assessment adjustments and fines ranging from USD 100 to USD 10,000.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies to licensed banks, insurers, stock-exchange issuers, and public-interest entities; an ordinary Panama S.A. may also be required to present audited financial statements when gross annual revenue exceeds USD 2,000,000, total assets exceed USD 5,000,000, or the DGI makes audit a condition of active operation in Panama.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB; IFRS for SMEs is permitted for qualifying nonpublic small and medium entities; Panama does not maintain a separate statutory local GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Law 23 of 2015 requires every Panama corporation to file an annual sworn declaration identifying each ultimate beneficial owner who directly or indirectly holds 10% or more of shares or voting rights; share transfers must be reported within 30 days; an S.A. with no Panamanian-source commercial activity files a simplified nil-operations declaration confirming no local revenue and confirming any historical ownership changes.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 850 per year depending on the resident law firm or corporate agent panel
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 12,000 per year if the audit threshold is triggered; USD 0 for a fully exempt nonoperating S.A.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation applies: a Panama S.A. is taxed only on income with a Panama source. There is no industry-specific statutory tax holiday for polyresin statue fabrication; the principal effective relief is the exclusion of foreign-source manufacturing and distribution profits from the taxable base. A taxpayer with no Panamanian-source activity may be required to file a nil return but owes no CITA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Declaración Jurada de Renta de Personas Jurídicas) filed through the Panama Dirección General de Ingresos online portal 'Sistema T@X'.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A., the statutory filing deadline is March 31 of the following year. Quarterly estimated payments of CITA are required on February 15, April 15, July 15, and October 15 based on projected annual taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year begin and end dates. Panamanian S.A.s commonly use the calendar year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owned S.A.s may elect a non-calendar fiscal year only if the administrator files timely notice; otherwise use January 1 to December 31.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name and Taxpayer Identification Number (RUC).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name shown on the corporate registration and the RUC obtained through the resident agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from Panamanian-source commercial activity, including domestic sales of resin statues, commissions, and payments for IP use in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero if all sales and activities are executed outside Panama and no income is derived from Panamanian-source operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Separately stated foreign-source income. Under territorial taxation, this amount is excluded from taxable net income but must still be declared for informational purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross revenues from foreign buyers, including Stripe/PayPal preorder receipts routed to foreign or U.S.-based acquiring accounts, as foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 20 - Costo de venta y gastos operativos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs directly related to Panamanian-source revenue, including resin raw materials, molding supplies, hand-painting labor, packaging, and shipping.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only expenses actually incurred outside or inside Panama and supported by invoices and bank records. Costs attributable to foreign-source income should be allocated separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama-source gross income minus allowable deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident S.A. with zero Panama-source income, enter zero.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax computed by applying the 25% statutory rate to taxable net income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute only on Panama-source taxable net income. If no Panama-source income exists, enter zero.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayments, foreign tax credits, and other creditable amounts under the Panamanian territorial tax system.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim any accrued tax prepayments made by the resident agent or remitted by the S.A.; retain payment receipts for audit evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Additional dividend tax due in relation to distributions of Panama-source profits. The rate is 5% for profits already taxed at the normal 25% CITA rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is typically paid by the S.A. before the dividend is credited. A non-resident shareholder must not net the dividend without the S.A. proving payment of this complementary tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 90 - Saldo a pagar o saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final settlement due to the Treasury or carryforward credit balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Even if zero tax is due, the return must be digitally signed and submitted to preserve the S.A.'s good standing and foreign clearance certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return triggers a 10% statutory surcharge on the final tax liability plus monthly default interest of approximately 1%. A formal fine for non-filing may also be imposed, and the taxpayer risks judicial collection, administrative embargoes, and denial of the 'certificado de cumplimiento fiscal' needed for banking, notarization, and corporate legalization.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% additional corporate dividend tax on distributions made from Panama-source profits that have already suffered the statutory 25% corporate income tax. If profits remain untaxed or are distributed under the small taxpayer/estimated-rate regime, the applicable rate is 10%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Invoke DTA relief by obtaining a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the shareholder's resident tax authority, having it notarized and translated into Spanish if required, and delivering the certificate to the Panamanian paying S.A. before the dividend is declared or paid. The S.A. must retain the TRC and supporting dividend board resolution for at least 5 years and, where the treaty provides a reduced rate, report the payment on the annual Form 200 and its accompanying annexes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid by a Panama S.A. for the use of intellectual property in Panama are Panama-source income subject to a 20% statutory withholding tax; DTA treaties may reduce the rate to approximately 10%. Interest paid to a non-resident creditor on a loan used in Panama is subject to a 6% statutory withholding rate, often reduced to 5% or lower under an applicable DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Panama's transfer pricing rules apply to taxpayers with gross income of at least US$10 million or related-party transactions exceeding US$1 million in a fiscal year. Below the threshold, the taxpayer must still maintain contemporaneous evidence supporting arm's length pricing in intercompany transactions involving resin statue sales, IP royalties, and cross-border advances.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations, enacted under Law 254 of 2021 and its implementing rules, apply to Panamanian resident entities deriving active income. A polyresin statue S.A. must be able to demonstrate adequate physical premises, qualified local employees, operational costs proportional to its income, and local direction of core business activities. Foreign-owned S.A.s with no employees or premises but which claim Panamanian tax residency or hold valuable IP must file the economic substance declaration and must satisfy the applicable substance test or face substantial fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowing omission of Panamanian-source sales, fabrication of false purchase invoices, underreporting of Stripe/PayPal gross receipts, or destruction of accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax fraud penalties of up to 100% of the tax evaded, monetary fines, business closure during penal proceedings, revocation of the S.A.'s annual operational permit, and inclusion in the DGI's public tax default registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns or instruct employees to conceal revenue are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, interest, and surcharges. Criminal tax proceedings may impose travel bans, attachment of personal assets, and imprisonment of the controlling director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the S.A. solely as a registered address with a Panama resident agent, holding resin statue production assets abroad, and booking profits under Panamanian territoriality without any Panamanian management, employees, or physical operational presence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Regulations impose a minimum fine of US$100,000 for non-compliance with the substance declaration and annual notification rules. Continuing non-compliance can lead to monetary penalties per month, disqualification of the resident agent, and potential dissolution proceedings against the S.A.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for ESR fines where they authorized the failure to appoint a local substance supervisor, failed to maintain employment records, or caused the company to operate as a mere nominee facade. Courts may pierce the corporate veil and order director restitution of assets diverted to foreign beneficiaries.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving customer preorders or sale proceeds without identifying beneficial owners, using personal or foreign stripped accounts for corporate sales, failing to maintain beneficial ownership records under Panama Law 254, or using the S.A. to reinvoice resin statue sales for third-party shell entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of Panama's AML Law No. 23 of 2015 and UAF regulations carry fines of up to US$1,000,000 per violation, suspension of the S.A.'s domicile capacity, blacklisting in the UAF public enforcement system, and criminal charges for money laundering with sentences of up to 12 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who tolerate AML deficiencies are subject to criminal prosecution, personal fines, travel bans, and confiscation of personal assets. Panamanian courts disregard corporate personality where the S.A. was used as a mere instrumentality for laundering payments, exposing the beneficial owner and directors to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring and paying dividends, royalties, or cross-border interest to non-residents without withholding the statutory Panama-source tax or without submitting the corresponding withholding tax return to the DGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Failure to withhold subjects the S.A. to a surcharge of 10% of the unwithheld tax plus monthly interest at the statutory rate. The royalty or interest expense may also be disallowed as a deduction, generating an additional 25% corporate income tax assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director or administrator responsible for authorizing dividend distributions without payment of the complementary dividend tax is personally liable to the DGI for the unwithheld amount. In fraudulent withholding schemes, the director may also incur criminal liability and a personal travel ban pending tax collection.
